vulnerabilities.description: UncheckedCall.forward(address,bytes) (test_contracts/UncheckedCall.sol#12-17) ignores the return value of a low-level call. Silent failures can leave the contract in an inconsistent state.
UncheckedCall.refund(address,uint256) (test_contracts/UncheckedCall.sol#19-24) uses send() without verifying the success boolean. If send fails the refund is silently lost.
UncheckedCall.deadline() (test_contracts/UncheckedCall.sol#28-32) uses block.timestamp as a comparison; miners can manipulate the value by ~15 seconds.
Outdated compiler ^0.7.6 lacks built-in overflow protection; consider migrating to >=0.8.0.
